outcome.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 (branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a declaration is journaled only after its exact tasks revision is approved, and never steps the core (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/analysis-link-declaration.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts). T2: a composite selects the current revision for each (unit_id, artifact_kind) stream before considering relation links, and keeps stages apart (observation/src/grading/composite.ts, observation/src/storage/grading-record-store.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #793 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #793, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and also runs bun test oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts once with OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL configured, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output from both commands. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/composite.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

body.summary: Implementable isolated audit with no blockers or unresolved operator decisions. PR #793 is open at head 3b07bcd0809d21d757afae025e9c3e87bf241a4f on cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e, targeting epic/grade-pray, with no open review threads. Repository evidence supports the T1 journal/no-core-step behavior and T2 link-independent current-selection and stage separation. Three wording/test-coverage qualifications should be incorporated before planning.

findings.description: T2 says current revision per unit, but the selector keys streams by [unit_id, artifact_kind], so a unit can retain one current revision for each artifact stream. observation/src/grading/composite.ts:114-134 implements this tuple key, and observation/tests/composite.test.ts:102-113 explicitly tests both per-unit independence and per-artifact independence. Revise T2 to name the actual stream key.

T2 says selection occurs before reading links. The storage layer reads source revisions, occurrences, and then all relations into one snapshot at observation/src/storage/grading-record-store.ts:29-75; the pure transform then computes revision standings before it filters or considers relation links at observation/src/grading/composite.ts:147-158 and 361-366. The required property is link-independent selection, not database read order, so the wording should say before considering links.

T1 is directly supported at the target commit: refusal validates that the exact tasks revision belongs to the run, is a tasks artifact, and has an approve decision at oakridge-dbos/src/domain/analysis-link-declaration.ts:43-53; commitAnalysisLinkDeclaration checks under the run lock and writes the declaration directly to authority.event without invoking the core step at oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:736-773. Tests encode the exact approval and no-state-movement cases at oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts:88-119 and 152-160.

The keeps-stages-apart part of T2 matches the implementation: each stage filters linked contributions before counts are derived and the result exposes only a stages array, with no cross-stage figure, at observation/src/grading/composite.ts:278-299 and 314-366. The direct integration scenario keeps supported implementation evidence separate from contradicted integration evidence at observation/tests/composite.test.ts:238-259.

The builder is instructed to run only the observation package test suite, while T1 direct behavior is covered by an integration-classified oakridge-dbos test. observation/package.json:6-9 runs only bun test ./tests; oakridge-dbos/tests/run-suite.sh:12-20 classifies analysis-link-declaration as integration. Without an additional targeted run, assessor output evidence can validate T2 but cannot directly validate T1.

The operational identity is reproducible without mutation: gated-review reports PR #793 head 3b07bcd0809d21d757afae025e9c3e87bf241a4f, branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e, base epic/grade-pray, draft/open state, and zero open review threads; the local origin head resolves to the same SHA. The specified detached checkout therefore identifies a concrete commit.

decisions.text: Use a single read-only cohort for the existing PR: detach origin/cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e, inspect that exact commit, and publish PR #793 rather than creating or changing a pull request.
For T1, verify that declarations are accepted only against the exact approved tasks revision, are journaled after validation, and bypass the workflow core step path.
For T2, verify currentness independently per (unit_id, artifact_kind) stream before links contribute, and verify that composite results never aggregate stages together.

Run bun run --filter observation test once and the configured OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL bun test oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts once; report actual counts and output, including inability to run as a known issue.

Require at least three distinct analysis findings overall and at least one assessment finding per task, all against the inspected SHA with path:start-end code citations plus separate test or output evidence; report builder output as test_evidence.

cohorts.description: T1 and T2 remain together because they are two review concerns in one existing repository PR and share the same immutable commit, builder evidence, PR artifact, and assessor handoff.

acceptance_criteria.text: Audit the PR diff and tests to determine whether an analysis-link declaration is journaled only for its exact approved tasks revision and never steps the core.
Audit the PR diff and tests to determine whether each (unit_id, artifact_kind) stream selects its own current revision before relation links are considered and whether stage results remain separate.

body.summary: Perform one immutable, read-only audit cohort for existing PR #793, covering the declaration authority invariant and composite revision/stage invariant with real command evidence and commit-pinned assessment.
acceptance_criteria: The analysis reports at least three separate, distinct findings about the specification.

The builder inspects the detached head of origin/cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e, makes no changes, runs each specified test command exactly once, and publishes build_result with that SHA and actual counts and output.
A test that cannot run is recorded as a known issue; no result or count is invented.
The builder publishes existing PR https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 with branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e and does not create or update a PR.

The assessor examines the same commit, supplies at least one finding for T1 and one for T2, cites code as path:start-end and test or output evidence separately, and reports builder output as test_evidence.
The brief introduces no additional operator choice or confirmation.
